posts.title: Sleep as a gateway to absolute consciousness
posts.description: This article delves into the Advaita Vedanta's philosophy on consciousness and the states of waking, dreaming, and dreamless sleep. Aditya Batura draws parallels between Vedanta and modern science, exploring how dreams affect waking consciousness and the role of the subconscious mind. The article also addresses the concept of turiya and the pursuit of transcendental consciousness.
